defects.description: The rise from 2 million to over 450 million tonnes is called 'more than a 20-fold increase', but 450 divided by 2 is about 225 — more than a 200-fold increase.
paraphrases: 450 divided by 2 is about 225, so it is a 200-fold, not 20-fold, increase.
A 20-fold rise from 2 million would be 40 million, not 450 million.
The stated multiple is about ten times too small.
defects.rationale: Correct phrasing 'more than a 200-fold' (450/2). Findable from the two tonnage figures, distinct.

defects.description: One-quarter of the 350 million tonnes of waste is given as 'roughly 250 million tonnes', but a quarter of 350 million is about 88 million, not 250 million.
paraphrases: A quarter of 350 million is roughly 88 million, not 250 million.
250 million would be more than two-thirds of 350 million, not a quarter.
The mismanaged tonnage does not match the stated one-quarter share.
defects.rationale: Correct value 'roughly 90 million' (350/4). Findable from the total and the share, distinct.

defects.description: 1-2 million tonnes reaching the ocean out of 350 million tonnes of waste is given as 'about 5%', but that ratio is about 0.5%.
paraphrases: 1.5 million out of 350 million is about 0.4%, not 5%.
The ocean share of plastic waste is overstated by roughly tenfold.
A couple of million tonnes is well under 1% of 350 million.
defects.rationale: Correct value 'about 0.5%' (1-2M / 350M). Findable from the ocean and total-waste figures, distinct.
